name: hash-sha512
algorithm: std SHA-512 over splitmix64 bytes, reps passes with a one-byte write-back (mk/hash-sha512.mk).

skip.c: no std hash: C has no standard SHA-512
skip.rust: no std SHA-512: Rust std has none (only SipHash-1-3 in DefaultHasher); no crate stands in

notes: Idiomatic standard library: one call of each language's std function per pass (plan/06-m6.md 4.1). Bytes per second = mib * 1048576 * reps / median.

Go: crypto/sha512 uses AVX2 on amd64 when the CPU has it. Mk does too since M9 item 11.24a (D-775): an AVX2 message schedule beside rounds compiled with bmi2 when the CPU has avx2 and bmi2 (run-time dispatch, whatever -mcpu says), else the scalar loop. Zig at -mcpu=x86_64_v2 is scalar, so on such a CPU the zig cell compares instruction sets as well as libraries.

Checksums: Mk (mk build -release), Zig 0.17.0 (-O ReleaseFast -mcpu=x86_64_v2) and, where it has the function, Go 1.27.3 (GOAMD64=v2) printed the same values for args and quick on the owner's machine, 2026-11-06 (std-hashmod session 1). The publish-size checksum was re-agreed by every column in `go run ./tools/bench verify -publish-size` on the owner's machine, 2026-11-07 (std-hashmod session 5, after the reps were raised). Not published: no number here is a measurement.
